name: Kraken BTC/USD one-minute Wilder ATR(14)
description: A causal reading over the fresh Kraken displayed best-quote midpoint, sampled once per second on the lane decision clock. Atr is Wilder's average true range over fourteen one-minute bars. True range is the greatest of the bar's high minus its low, the absolute difference between its high and the previous bar's close, and the absolute difference between its low and the previous bar's close. The first average is the arithmetic mean of the first fourteen true ranges and every later one is Wilder's smoothing, previous average plus (current true range minus previous average) divided by fourteen. atr_bps is atr divided by the latest bar close, times ten thousand, and is scale-free. close is that latest bar close and bar_count the number of contiguous closed bars behind the reading. The fourteen-bar period is the standard Wilder length and is an initial research default that requires empirical calibration; the true-range and smoothing formulas are not heuristic thresholds. One-minute bars are closed on the lane decision clock at minute boundaries from the one-second sample series: open is the first sample of the minute, high and low its extrema, close its last sample. A bar that is missing any one-second sample is invalid; the missing sample breaks continuity, every retained bar and every smoothed state derived from them is discarded, and the bar warm-up restarts from the next whole bar. Nothing is bridged across a gap. Ready once fifteen contiguous one-minute bars have closed (fourteen true ranges need fifteen closes). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even. Every reading is causal: it reads only samples at or before the decision it is published on. Adopted in the C3a TA pack (ruling E51, 2026-09-04): the seven technical-analysis identities are published on every price venue we carry, computed from the venue's own one-second sample ring by the shared `crates/btc-signals/src/ta.rs` helper, so every scope runs byte-identical arithmetic and only the sample series differs.
